title: Do c43's conserved-enzyme consumers become free hunters between meals if they get a nonreciprocal cross-current toward prey material?
summary: In 20261026T1700-c43-cips-consumer the consumers are bands on prey droplets and dissolve when their prey are gone, so whether they are individuals is doubtful. Add to the consumer flux a nonreciprocal drift up the prey field (q drifts toward c_a, prey does not respond; Saha et al. 2020, Meredith et al. 2020) and test whether consumers leave an eaten droplet as a compact body and reach the next one.
experiment: world.py of 20261026T1700-c43-cips-consumer plus -div(chi_h q(1-q) grad c_a) in the q equation; scan chi_h 0-20 on seed 0 (128^2, t=6000); measure the share of consumer bodies not touching prey, consumer persistent splits, and the prey-removal fork; matched chi_h=0 arm.
